articles.title: Europe's rivers are drying up. Can they be saved?
articles.summary: The Rhine and Danube have reached historic lows. Dwindling water levels are affecting shipping, agriculture and ecosystems — and raising concerns about the future of drinking water supplies.

articles.title: Trump administration to pay German firm $1.2bn to halt US wind projects
articles.summary: The RWE payout is the latest in a string of deals cancelling wind energy projects, a power source long derided by Trump.

articles.title: Fierce backlash to Ethereum’s EIP-8363 staking proposal
articles.summary: Ethereum’s proposed EIP-8363 staking overhaul aims to reduce issuance, but critics say it could hurt DeFi, decentralization and institutional adoption.
